A square gold-edged medallion with clipped corners, dark inset background and bold central emblem. Hard-edged, deliberate crisp pixel art, low resolution sprite aesthetic with large uniform square pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, limited 16-color palette, bold dark pixel outlines, subtle dithering only, top-left highlights. The square badge dark inset is opaque. Match an SNES era fantasy RPG inventory icon. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no extra icons, no mockup, no drop shadow outside badge. Output transparent PNG. Deliver exactly one icon.
